title: MSPS: Monocrystalline Silicon Photovoltaic Cell Defect Segmentation Dataset
mechanism: 1,500 production-line mono EL cells (640x590, 1,000 train / 500 test) with pixel masks for crack, busbar break and black spot, each annotated by two experts and adjudicated by a third.
adaptation: Joint training with a separate output head per dataset (MSPS 4-class head, BenchmarkEL 24-class head) on a shared U-Net++ encoder-decoder, so label conventions never mix; rescale MSPS so crack line width in px matches ours (about 1.75 px), 1-channel input as is. Its double annotation also gives an inter-annotator reference for the benchmark's tolerant crack metric.
min_experiment: Arm: PF + MSPS joint (own head, 1:1 batch mix). Baseline: PF, 5 v 5 seeds. Metrics: E1 crack relF1@2 and recall, test crack IoU. Kill if E1 relF1@2 gain < 0.03 or test crack IoU drops > 0.012.
evidence: R: dataset record only; associated paper (DACN) not found, no model numbers seen.
prior_overlap: Partial: +107 E-SCDD cells n.d. and UCF-EL pretraining erased by fine-tune. Joint multi-dataset training with separate heads, and a new source, are untested.
